references.text: The Levites were appointed to serve at the tabernacle and keep watch over it, which corresponds to their service in the tent of meeting.
The Levites were to perform guard duty for Aaron and the entire congregation at the tent of meeting, describing their role as keepers of the watch.
The context for the age limit for the Levites' service, where from 50 years old they were to withdraw from active service.
The Levites were to join the priests and serve them, and keep watch at the tent of meeting.
The duties of the Levites under David included helping Aaron's sons with the service in the house of the Lord and keeping watch.
The registration of the Levites from 20 years old and upward for service in the house of the Lord shows the continuity of their service role.
